prompts.name: analyze-synthetic-panel
prompts.title: Analyze a synthetic biomarker panel
prompts.description: Guide the model through analyzing a SYNTHETIC biomarker panel with PRISM and explaining the results in plain language. Never use real PHI.

arguments.name: biomarkers_json
arguments.description: JSON map of biomarker name -> numeric value, e.g. {"HbA1c": 6.4}. SYNTHETIC ONLY.

arguments.name: condition
arguments.description: Optional track: general_wellness | type2_diabetes | lupus | cancer_survivorship
